profile_text.body:
Pony AI Inc. describes itself as a leading global autonomous driving technology company. According to its website, it was founded in 2016 in Silicon Valley and operates three business units: Robotaxi, Robotruck, and Personally Owned Vehicles (POV). The company says it has accumulated millions of kilometers in autonomous road testing and that its autonomous vehicles had traveled over 32 million kilometers (over 13 million miles) on urban roads and highways as of April 2024. It also states that it holds licenses and credentials to test and operate autonomous driving vehicles in multiple locations worldwide.

The company positions its core technology, which it calls the virtual driver, at the center of its autonomous driving work across the Robotaxi, Robotruck, and POV units. It describes its aim as delivering autonomous driving systems at scale for everyday travel and commercial logistics. The site presents Pony AI Inc. as a pioneer in extending autonomous mobility technologies and services globally.

Pony AI Inc. is a for-profit public company with ticker PONY and CIK 0001969302. Its headquarters are listed as Guangzhou, F4. No litigation is recorded for the company.
